text_block_list.text:
After winning the Japanese Derby,
Нарита Брайан is
focused on winning more
than ever before.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Expectations from fans rise again as talk

circulates that she might be able to win
five G1
races if she keeps up the pace.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Хиши Амадзон has just won
the second
tiara on the Tiara tour. The
two of them decide to
settle their rivalry
at the Arima Kinen once both
Classic
Triple Crown series are finished.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The challenge spikes Нарита Брайан's
fighting spirit.
Before that match,
however, we have the Kikuka
Sho—the
final race of the Classic Triple Crown!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
